newsitem.title: USA: MicroTouch sees higher operating margins.
newsitem.headline: MicroTouch sees higher operating margins.

text.p: MicroTouch Systems Inc expects its operating margins to improve now that a product it spent heavily to develop is ready for market, its chief executive officer said on Monday.
Wes Davis, the company's CEO, said its business model calls for operating margins of 10 to 12 percent. The margin was 9.7 percent in the third quarter and 7.9 percent in the second.

MicroTouch, which specializes in touchscreen technologies, recently completed the development of its Ibid product, a digital whiteboard that allows drawings to be captured by a personal computer and distributed through PC networks.
